notes.title: The Inn-Sanity is now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Our game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688570/The_InnSanity/]The Inn-Sanity,[/url] is out! Now it's in Early Access and on sale!

The Inn-Sanity is a story-driven horror. It begins with the mass transformation of people into monsters. You and several others find yourself locked in a hotel and must find a way to get out. With each passing day influence of the hotel will grow.

Here's what lies in the hotel:
• Various memorable monsters. You'll have to run from some and hide from others. Some of them you'll have to persuade.
• Intense conversations with paranoid survivors and insane creatures. In order to survive, you need to find the right approach to each dialogue.
• Several endings. Your decisions will determine the future for yourself and other guests of the hotel.
• The hotel is changing. The environment is getting darker, stranger and more hostile with each passing day.

Welcome to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688570/The_InnSanity/]hotel[/url]!

notes.title: Trailer for The Inn-Sanity — Our new horror!
notes.notes:
We've released a trailer for our new game - The Inn-Sanity. This is a plot-driven horror about several days in a hotel filled with monsters.

The Inn-Sanity will be released in the second half of summer. Wishlist it on it's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688570/The_InnSanity/]Steam page[/url] so you don't miss the release!

notes.title: Our new game Prognostic is available in Early Access
notes.notes:
Our team has been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671280/Prognostic/]Prognostic [/url]for over a year and now you can finally play it. In this mystical horror, you will be able to solve crimes through communication with spirits. 

Every evening you will be sent a new case, which you can solve with the help of ancient rites (such as Tarot, dowsing, runes and others). Various fortune-telling rituals give their own clues, so you determine the course of the investigation. But remember — contact with spirits may draw some unwanted attention. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671280/Prognostic/]Hurry up to grab Prognostic with a 21% Halloween discount! [/url]

notes.title: House on the Hill has been released on Steam
notes.notes:
Our new game, [b]House on the Hill[/b], has been released on Steam. It is a story-driven mystery that combines various horror genres in a single narrative.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239050/House_on_the_Hill/

You will be playing as a thief and your family is in trouble. In order to help it, you decided to accept a dangerous job — to steal a jewel from an old manor. Getting there wasn't easy, but it will be much more difficult to get out.

Each playthrough is a separate story with its own ending. All of them allow you to lift the veil over the secrets of the mansion. What is hidden in the house? What is your partner hiding? What are you hiding?

[h2]What awaits you:[/h2]
[list][*]Discover all [b]secrets [/b]that are hidden behind the old walls of this gloomy house.
[*]Each walkthrough is [b]unique [/b]and leads to its own story and ending.	
[*]An intriguing story full of [b]drama and horror[/b].
[*]A huge Victorian estate is [b]open for exploration[/b].
[*][b]Riddles and puzzles[/b] that guard the hidden passages and secrets of the house.
[*][b]Non-linear walkthrough[/b]. Explore the house the way you want.[/list]

Get it with 21% discount!
